header.note: Ground truth for ReportMath.swift, produced by executing each operation in V8. Where Swift and this file disagree, THIS FILE IS RIGHT — including where it disagrees with the ECMA-262 note on Math.round. Regenerate with make-reportmath-corpus.mjs; --verify is wired into `npm run check:all`.

encoding.value: IEEE-754 binary64 as 16 uppercase hex digits, big-endian. JSON cannot carry -0, NaN or Infinity, which are the values these shims exist to get right.
encoding.nan: Every NaN is written as the canonical 7FF8000000000000; payloads are not architecturally guaranteed, so the Swift side compares NaN by is-a-NaN.
encoding.nullValue: JSON null in an argument means JS null/undefined and SQL NULL alike — all three reach Swift as nil.
encoding.case: [op, args[], result, tag, repr] — repr is documentation, never ground truth.
